title: The Jingkang Incident
synopsis: Emperor Huizong of Song was a talented artist, but his reign ended in humiliation and calamity when the Jurchen-led Jin dynasty defeated the Song. The Jingkang Incident became a national trauma, marking the fall of the Northern Song and the royal court’s flight south to establish the Southern Song.

series.title: The Splendor of the Song Dynasty

fullText.simplified:
靖康之变：艺术家皇帝的悲剧

    酷玩乐队曾在歌曲《Viva La Vida》中，以路易十六的视角来歌颂生命。然而这只是一种艺术上的创造，当代人很难知道路易十六被自己改良的断头台处决时，究竟在想些什么。不过，中国历史上的一个人或许能与他产生一些共鸣，因为他们的人生经历颇为相似。这个人就是北宋“靖康之变”的亲历者——宋徽宗。
    宋徽宗，名叫赵佶。他是宋神宗的第十一个儿子，由于排行靠后，而且母亲早逝，因此没人想到他会是未来的皇帝。他的成长过程里没有系统的军政教育，而是遵循天性自由发展。他从小就展现出了卓越的艺术天赋，不仅自创了著名的“瘦金体”书法，而且他本人还是顶级的画家，为后世留下了不少珍贵的画作。他本想做一辈子闲散王爷，却意外继承了一份沉重的“礼物”——皇位。
    1100年，年仅25岁的皇帝宋哲宗突然去世，他没有儿子，人们选择他的弟弟赵佶继承皇位。就这样，19岁的赵佶成了宋朝的第八位皇帝，即宋徽宗。刚刚即位时，他尽量表现得像个皇帝，坚持跟大臣见面，也努力批阅文件。但他很舍不得以前自由的生活，对从政不感兴趣，也力不从心，逐渐变得懒于政务，沉迷于绘画。他把理政工作交给了蔡京、童贯等人，但这些人善于蒙蔽，而且很会迎合他的爱好，陪他搞艺术、踢足球，耗费大量财力帮他收集奇珍异宝。他很享受这样的生活，但老百姓的日子却越来越苦，各地都爆发了农民起义。
    25年之后，北方的金朝人发现宋朝不仅国力大不如前，而且军队腐败，缺少战斗力，于是发兵侵略宋朝。金军一路南下，宋徽宗吓得将皇位紧急传给儿子，自己做起了太上皇。一年后，金军攻破宋朝首都汴京的城墙，俘虏了皇宫里的宋徽宗和他的皇帝儿子，并将他们和宫中妃嫔、官员、工匠等数千人，一起抓到了东北，这就是历史上有名的“靖康之变”。后世以“靖康之变”为节点，将宋朝分为北宋和南宋。“靖康之变”之前的宋朝被称为北宋，之后的宋朝被称为南宋。被抓走的宋徽宗在金朝受尽侮辱，最终在54岁时因不堪精神折磨死在了寒冷的东北，结束了艺术家皇帝的一生。
    回望宋徽宗的一生，他以艺术家的热情对待生活，创立皇家画院，为北宋辉煌的文化发展发挥了重要的作用。但他也以政治家的麻木对待责任，疏忽懒政，任用奸臣，将人民推向了痛苦的深渊，最终导致北宋终结在了金朝骑兵的马蹄之下。
fullText.traditional:
靖康之變：藝術家皇帝的悲劇

    酷玩樂隊曾在歌曲《Viva La Vida》中，以路易十六的視角來歌頌生命。然而這只是一種藝術上的創造，當代人很難知道路易十六被自己改良的斷頭台處決時，究竟在想些什麼。不過，中國歷史上的一個人或許能與他產生一些共鳴，因為他們的人生經歷頗為相似。這個人就是北宋“靖康之變”的親歷者——宋徽宗。
    宋徽宗，名叫趙佶。他是宋神宗的第十一個兒子，由於排行靠後，而且母親早逝，因此沒人想到他會是未來的皇帝。他的成長過程裡沒有系統的軍政教育，而是遵循天性自由發展。他從小就展現出了卓越的藝術天賦，不僅自創了著名的“瘦金體”書法，而且他本人還是頂級的畫家，為後世留下了不少珍貴的畫作。他本想做一輩子閑散王爺，卻意外繼承了一份沉重的“禮物”——皇位。
    1100年，年僅25歲的皇帝宋哲宗突然去世，他沒有兒子，人們選擇他的弟弟趙佶繼承皇位。就這樣，19歲的趙佶成了宋朝的第八位皇帝，即宋徽宗。剛剛即位時，他儘量表現得像個皇帝，堅持跟大臣見面，也努力批閱文件。但他很捨不得以前自由的生活，對從政不感興趣，也力不從心，逐漸變得懶於政務，沉迷於繪畫。他把理政工作交給了蔡京、童貫等人，但這些人善於蒙蔽，而且很會迎合他的愛好，陪他搞藝術、踢足球，耗費大量財力幫他收集奇珍異寶。他很享受這樣的生活，但老百姓的日子卻越來越苦，各地都爆發了農民起義。
    25年之後，北方的金朝人發現宋朝不僅國力大不如前，而且軍隊腐敗，缺少戰鬥力，於是發兵侵略宋朝。金軍一路南下，宋徽宗嚇得將皇位緊急傳給兒子，自己做起了太上皇。一年後，金軍攻破宋朝首都汴京的城牆，俘虜了皇宮裡的宋徽宗和他的皇帝兒子，並將他們和宮中妃嬪、官員、工匠等數千人，一起抓到了東北，這就是歷史上有名的“靖康之變”。後世以“靖康之變”為節點，將宋朝分為北宋和南宋。“靖康之變”之前的宋朝被稱為北宋，之後的宋朝被稱為南宋。被抓走的宋徽宗在金朝受盡侮辱，最終在54歲時因不堪精神折磨死在了寒冷的東北，結束了藝術家皇帝的一生。
    回望宋徽宗的一生，他以藝術家的熱情對待生活，創立皇家畫院，為北宋輝煌的文化發展發揮了重要的作用。但他也以政治家的麻木對待責任，疏忽懶政，任用奸臣，將人民推向了痛苦的深淵，最終導致北宋終結在了金朝騎兵的馬蹄之下。

sentences.simplified: 这就是历史上有名的“靖康之变”。
sentences.traditional: 這就是歷史上有名的“靖康之變”。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì lì shǐ shang yǒu míng de jìng kāng zhī biàn
sentences.english: They also abducted several thousand concubines, officials, and artisans from the palace and took them to the northeast.

sentences.simplified: 后世以“靖康之变”为节点，将宋朝分为北宋和南宋。
sentences.traditional: 後世以“靖康之變”為節點，將宋朝分為北宋和南宋。
sentences.pinyin: hòu shì yǐ jìng kāng zhī biàn wéi jié diǎn jiāng sòng cháo fēn wéi běi sòng hé nán sòng
sentences.english: This is the “Jingkang Incident” of historical fame.

sentences.simplified: “靖康之变”之前的宋朝被称为北宋，之后的宋朝被称为南宋。
sentences.traditional: “靖康之變”之前的宋朝被稱為北宋，之後的宋朝被稱為南宋。
sentences.pinyin: jìng kāng zhī biàn zhī qián de sòng cháo bèi chēng wéi běi sòng zhī hòu de sòng cháo bèi chēng wéi nán sòng
sentences.english: Later generations used the Jingkang Incident as a turning point to divide the Song dynasty into the Northern Song and the Southern Song.

sentences.simplified: 被抓走的宋徽宗在金朝受尽侮辱，
sentences.traditional: 被抓走的宋徽宗在金朝受盡侮辱，
sentences.pinyin: bèi zhuā zǒu de sòng huī zōng zài jīn cháo shòu jìn wǔ rǔ
sentences.english: The Song dynasty before the Jingkang Incident is known as the Northern Song, and the period after it is known as the Southern Song.

sentences.simplified: 最终在54岁时因不堪精神折磨死在了寒冷的东北，结束了艺术家皇帝的一生。
sentences.traditional: 最終在54歲時因不堪精神折磨死在了寒冷的東北，結束了藝術家皇帝的一生。
sentences.pinyin: zuì zhōng zài 3 suì shí yīn bù kān jīng shén zhé mó sǐ zài le hán lěng de dōng běi jié shù le yì shù jiā huáng dì de yì shēng
sentences.english: The captured Emperor Huizong suffered endless humiliation in the Jin dynasty.
Ultimately, unable to bear the mental torment, he died at the age of fifty-four in the cold northeast, ending his life as an artist emperor.

sentences.simplified: 回望宋徽宗的一生，
sentences.traditional: 回望宋徽宗的一生，
sentences.pinyin: huí wàng sòng huī zōng de yì shēng

sentences.simplified: 他以艺术家的热情对待生活，创立皇家画院，
sentences.traditional: 他以藝術家的熱情對待生活，創立皇家畫院，
sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ yì shù jiā de rè qíng duì dài shēng huó chuàng lì huáng jiā huà yuàn
sentences.english: Looking back on the life of Emperor Huizong of Song, ..

sentences.simplified: 为北宋辉煌的文化发展发挥了重要的作用。
sentences.traditional: 為北宋輝煌的文化發展發揮了重要的作用。
sentences.pinyin: wèi běi sòng huī huáng de wén huà fā zhǎn fā huī le zhòng yào de zuò yòng
sentences.english: .. he approached life with the passion of an artist, and established the Imperial Painting Academy.

sentences.simplified: 但他也以政治家的麻木对待责任，
sentences.traditional: 但他也以政治家的麻木對待責任，
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā yě yǐ zhèng zhì jiā de má mù duì dài zé rèn
sentences.english: He played an important role in the flourishing cultural development of the Northern Song.

sentences.simplified: 疏忽懒政，任用奸臣，将人民推向了痛苦的深渊，
sentences.traditional: 疏忽懶政，任用奸臣，將人民推向了痛苦的深淵，
sentences.pinyin: shū hu lǎn zhèng rèn yòng jiān chén jiāng rén mín tuī xiàng le tòng kǔ de shēn yuān
sentences.english: But he also approached his responsibilities as a politician with indifference.

sentences.simplified: 最终导致北宋终结在了金朝骑兵的马蹄之下。
sentences.traditional: 最終導致北宋終結在了金朝騎兵的馬蹄之下。
sentences.pinyin: zuì zhōng dǎo zhì běi sòng zhōng jié zài le jīn cháo qí bīng de mǎ tí zhī xià
sentences.english: He neglected governance and appointed treacherous officials, pushing his people into an abyss of suffering ..

sentence_translations: The Jingkang Incident: The Tragedy of an Artist Emperor
In the song “Viva La Vida”, Coldplay celebrate life from the perspective of Louis XVI.
However, this is merely an artistic creation.
It is hard for people today to know what Louis XVI was truly thinking when he was executed by the guillotine he himself had improved.
However, there is a person in Chinese history who might have shared a similar feeling to him, ..
.. because their life experiences were rather similar.
This person experienced the “Jingkang Incident” of the Northern Song dynasty firsthand—Emperor Huizong of Song.
Emperor Huizong of Song’s personal name was Zhao Ji. He was the eleventh son of Emperor Shenzong of Song.
Because he was far down the line of succession and his mother passed away early, no one expected him to become the future emperor.
As he was growing up, he received no systematic military or political education.
Instead, he followed his natural inclinations and developed freely.
From a young age, he exhibited exceptional artistic talent.
He not only created the famous “Slender Gold” calligraphy style, ..
.. but was also an outstanding painter, leaving behind many valuable artworks for future generations.
He had intended to live his life as a carefree prince, but unexpectedly inherited a heavy “gift”—the imperial throne.
In the year 1100, Emperor Zhezong of Song died suddenly at the age of only twenty-five.
He had no sons, so his younger brother Zhao Ji was chosen to ascend to the throne.
And so, at the age of nineteen, Zhao Ji became the eighth emperor of the Song dynasty, Emperor Huizong of Song.
When he first ascended the throne, he tried his best to act like an emperor.
He insisted on meeting with his ministers and worked hard to review official documents.
But he found it hard to give up the freedom of his earlier life.
He was uninterested in politics and lacked the ability to handle state affairs.
Gradually, he grew negligent in state affairs and indulged in painting.
He entrusted the affairs of government to officials such as Cai Jing and Tong Guan.
However, these people were adept at deception and were very good at pandering to his interests.
They kept him company as he did art and played football, and spent a huge amount of financial resources to help him collect rare treasures.
He greatly enjoyed this kind of life.
However, the lives of the ordinary people became increasingly difficult, and peasant uprisings erupted in various regions.
After twenty-five years, ..
.. the people of the Jin dynasty in the north discovered that the Song dynasty was not only much weaker than before, ..
.. but also that its army was corrupt and lacked combat effectiveness, so they sent troops to invade the Song dynasty.
As the Jin forces advanced southward, Emperor Huizong, in a panic, hastily abdicated in favor of his son ..
.. and took the title of Emperor Emeritus.
A year later, the Jin army breached the walls of the Song capital Bianjing, ..
.. and captured Emperor Huizong along with his son, the reigning emperor.
They also abducted several thousand concubines, officials, and artisans from the palace and took them to the northeast.
This is the “Jingkang Incident” of historical fame.
Later generations used the Jingkang Incident as a turning point to divide the Song dynasty into the Northern Song and the Southern Song.
The Song dynasty before the Jingkang Incident is known as the Northern Song, and the period after it is known as the Southern Song.
The captured Emperor Huizong suffered endless humiliation in the Jin dynasty.
Ultimately, unable to bear the mental torment, he died at the age of fifty-four in the cold northeast, ending his life as an artist emperor.
Looking back on the life of Emperor Huizong of Song, ..
.. he approached life with the passion of an artist, and established the Imperial Painting Academy.
He played an important role in the flourishing cultural development of the Northern Song.
But he also approached his responsibilities as a politician with indifference.
He neglected governance and appointed treacherous officials, pushing his people into an abyss of suffering ..
.. ultimately leading to the Northern Song’s downfall under the hooves of the Jin cavalry.
